WITH base AS (
SELECT date_trunc('day',te.datetime) ts,te.machine_id::VARCHAR||'|'||COALESCE(m.model,'Unknown') entity,m.model segment,
AVG(te.rotate) metric,COALESCE(er.n,0)+COALESCE(ma.n,0)+COALESCE(fa.n,0) event_count
FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/azure-pdm/tables/telemetry.parquet') te JOIN read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/azure-pdm/tables/machines.parquet') m USING(machine_id)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT machine_id,date_trunc('day',datetime) d,COUNT(*) n FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/azure-pdm/tables/errors.parquet') GROUP BY ALL) er ON te.machine_id=er.machine_id AND date_trunc('day',te.datetime)=er.d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT machine_id,date_trunc('day',datetime) d,COUNT(*) n FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/azure-pdm/tables/maintenance.parquet') GROUP BY ALL) ma ON te.machine_id=ma.machine_id AND date_trunc('day',te.datetime)=ma.d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT machine_id,date_trunc('day',datetime) d,COUNT(*) n FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/azure-pdm/tables/failures.parquet') GROUP BY ALL) fa ON te.machine_id=fa.machine_id AND date_trunc('day',te.datetime)=fa.d
WHERE te.datetime>='2015-01-01' AND te.datetime<'2016-01-01' GROUP BY ALL), a AS (SELECT segment,AVG(metric) FILTER(WHERE ts<'2015-04-01') early_mean,
AVG(metric) FILTER(WHERE ts>='2015-04-01') late_mean,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE ts<'2015-04-01') early_n,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE ts>='2015-04-01') late_n FROM base GROUP BY segment
HAVING early_n>=40 AND late_n>=40), s AS (SELECT *,late_mean-early_mean change FROM a)
SELECT segment,ROUND(early_mean,4) early_mean,ROUND(late_mean,4) late_mean,ROUND(change,4) change,early_n,late_n
FROM s QUALIFY change=MAX(change) OVER() ORDER BY segment

WITH base AS (
WITH meter AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',timestamp) ts,building_id,AVG(reading) reading
 FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/bdg2/tables/meter_readings_benchmark.parquet') WHERE cleaning_state='cleaned' AND meter_type='electricity'
 AND timestamp>='2016-01-01' AND timestamp<'2018-01-01' GROUP BY ALL),
weather AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',timestamp) ts,site_id,AVG(air_temperature) avg_temperature
 FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/bdg2/tables/weather_hourly.parquet') WHERE timestamp>='2016-01-01' AND timestamp<'2018-01-01' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT m.ts,m.building_id||'|'||COALESCE(b.primaryspaceusage,'Unknown') entity,COALESCE(b.primaryspaceusage,'Unknown') segment,
m.reading metric,CASE WHEN w.avg_temperature IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN w.avg_temperature>=25 OR w.avg_temperature<=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END event_count
FROM meter m JOIN read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/bdg2/tables/buildings.parquet') b USING(building_id)
LEFT JOIN weather w ON b.site_id=w.site_id AND m.ts=w.ts), a AS (SELECT segment,AVG((event_count>0)::INT) FILTER(WHERE ts<'2017-01-01') early_rate,
AVG((event_count>0)::INT) FILTER(WHERE ts>='2017-01-01') late_rate,COUNT(event_count) FILTER(WHERE ts<'2017-01-01') early_n,
COUNT(event_count) FILTER(WHERE ts>='2017-01-01') late_n FROM base GROUP BY segment HAVING early_n>=80 AND late_n>=80),
s AS (SELECT *,late_rate-early_rate rate_change FROM a)
SELECT segment,ROUND(early_rate,4) early_rate,ROUND(late_rate,4) late_rate,ROUND(rate_change,4) rate_change,early_n,late_n
FROM s QUALIFY ABS(rate_change)=MAX(ABS(rate_change)) OVER() ORDER BY segment

FROM read_parquet('${DATA_ROOT}/skillmtts/standardized/rel-stack/tables/questions.parquet') q LEFT JOIN com c ON q.id=c.question_id LEFT JOIN ans a ON q.id=a.question_id
WHERE q.creation_date>='2010-01-01' AND q.creation_date<'2024-01-01'),
monthly AS (
 SELECT segment,date_trunc('month',ts) period_month,
        AVG(metric) y,AVG((event_count>0)::INT) event_rate,COUNT(*) n
 FROM base
 WHERE ts>=DATE '2010-01-01' AND ts<DATE '2024-01-01' AND segment IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY segment,period_month HAVING COUNT(*)>=3
),a AS (SELECT segment,STDDEV_SAMP(y) FILTER(WHERE period_month<date_trunc('month',DATE '2020-01-01')) early_volatility,
STDDEV_SAMP(y) FILTER(WHERE period_month>=date_trunc('month',DATE '2020-01-01')) late_volatility,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE period_month<date_trunc('month',DATE '2020-01-01')) early_months,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE period_month>=date_trunc('month',DATE '2020-01-01')) late_months FROM monthly GROUP BY segment HAVING early_months>=3 AND late_months>=3),
s AS (SELECT *,late_volatility-early_volatility volatility_change FROM a)
SELECT segment,ROUND(early_volatility,4) early_volatility,ROUND(late_volatility,4) late_volatility,
ROUND(volatility_change,4) volatility_change,early_months,late_months FROM s
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ABS(volatility_change) DESC,segment)<=3 ORDER BY ABS(volatility_change) DESC,segment
